steps.body: If you cut a whole into fourths, two of those fourths together make one half. Fourths are smaller pieces than halves — it takes 2 of them to match 1 half.
How many fourths make a half?

predict.prompt: You will add fourths one at a time. How many will it take to reach the half mark?
predict.reveal: A half is one of two equal parts, and a fourth is one of four. Two fourths side by side reach exactly as far as one half — you are about to watch them land on the same spot.

widget.prompt: Make fourths until your bar reaches the half mark. How many fourths did it take?

commonFractions.feedback: One fourth is only half as far as the half mark. Add one more fourth and look again.
Four fourths fill the WHOLE bar, not half of it. Take some away and stop at the half mark.

widget.lowFeedback: Not far enough yet. Keep adding fourths until you reach the half mark.
widget.highFeedback: That went past the half mark. Take a fourth away.
widget.successFeedback: Two fourths! The bar stops in exactly the same place as one half. That is why 2/4 and 1/2 are two names for the same amount — the pieces are smaller, so you need more of them to go the same distance.

explanationVariants: Cutting into more pieces (fourths) makes each piece smaller than a half.
A fourth is one of 4 pieces; a half is one of only 2 — so a fourth is smaller.

widget.prompt: Which is smaller: a half or a fourth?

options.label: a fourth
options.feedback: Yes — cutting into 4 pieces instead of 2 makes each piece smaller.

options.label: a half
options.feedback: A half is one of only 2 pieces, so it's the BIGGER piece, not smaller.

options.label: they're the same size
options.feedback: They're not the same — a fourth is smaller than a half.

steps.body: Think of a pizza: split into halves, each person gets a big piece. Split into fourths, each person gets a smaller piece — but 2 of those small pieces put together equal 1 big half-piece.

widget.prompt: How many fourths make the whole thing?

commonErrors.feedback: 2 fourths only make a half, not the whole. The whole needs 4 fourths.
1 fourth is just one small piece. The whole needs all 4 fourths.

steps.body: So halves and fourths connect: 2 halves make a whole, and 4 fourths make a whole — and 2 fourths make 1 half. More pieces always means smaller pieces.

widget.prompt: How many halves make the whole thing?

commonErrors.feedback: 4 is how many fourths make the whole. Only 2 halves make the whole.
1 half is just one piece, not the whole thing.

explanationVariants: Half of the 4 fourths is 2 fourths — that's 1 half.

widget.prompt: How many fourths make one half?

commonErrors.feedback: That's the whole, not a half. 2 fourths make a half.
3 fourths is more than a half. It takes exactly 2 fourths to make a half.

explanationVariants: A half is bigger because it comes from cutting into fewer pieces.
Fewer cuts means bigger pieces — a half beats a fourth.

widget.prompt: Which is bigger: a half or a fourth?

options.label: a half
options.feedback: Yes — a half is bigger, since it's only one of 2 pieces, not 4.

options.label: a fourth
options.feedback: A fourth is smaller — it comes from cutting into 4 pieces instead of 2.

options.label: they're the same size
options.feedback: They're not the same — a half is bigger than a fourth.

explanationVariants: 2 fourths make a half, and 2 halves make the whole — so 2 + 2 = 4 fourths in all.
The whole is 4 fourths, matching 2 halves.

widget.prompt: If 2 fourths make a half, and 2 halves make the whole, how many fourths make the whole?

commonErrors.feedback: 2 fourths only make a half. The WHOLE needs all 4 fourths.
That's more fourths than the whole has. The whole is exactly 4 fourths.

hints: So 2 halves × 2 fourths-per-half = 4 fourths in the whole.

steps.body: More pieces means smaller pieces — 2 fourths always make 1 half.
takeaways: A fourth is smaller than a half.
steps.teaser: you've finished Shapes & Fractions this chapter — next, comparing lengths.

concept.body: A fourth is smaller than a half, because it comes from cutting into 4 pieces instead of 2. Two fourths together always make one half.

explanationVariants: Two of the smaller pieces equal one half.

widget.prompt: A pizza is cut into 4 equal slices (fourths). You want to give a friend exactly half the pizza. How many slices do you hand them?

commonErrors.feedback: All 4 slices is the WHOLE pizza, not half of it. Half is 2 of the 4 slices.
1 slice is only a fourth of the pizza — not enough. It takes 2 fourths to make a half.

widget.fallbackFeedback: 2 of the 4 slices make exactly half the pizza.
